verdict.rationale: Docs describe assigning tasks to multiple agents (Copilot, Claude, Codex) that plan/explore/execute autonomously in the background, tracking progress across multiple agent sessions from one workspace/control page, and scheduling cloud agent runs via automations with isolated sandboxes — directly supporting parallel, long-running autonomous agent fleets. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of multi-hour/multi-day task durations, concrete scale limits (how many agents in parallel), and independent/hands-on evidence corroborating sustained autonomous operation beyond vendor docs.
